get_current_user.title: Get the current user
get_current_user.description: Return the user ID and team ID of the Canva user the connection acts for. Needs no scope. Use get_user_profile for the display name and get_user_capabilities to learn which plan-gated APIs the user can call.

output.description: The user's IDs.

get_user_profile.title: Get the user's profile
get_user_profile.description: Return the profile of the connected Canva user; currently just their display name. Use get_current_user for the user and team IDs.

output.description: The profile.

get_user_capabilities.title: Get the user's API capabilities
get_user_capabilities.description: List the plan-gated API capabilities the connected user has: analytics, autofill, background_removal, brand_template, design_generation, export_png_transparency, image_generation, image_to_design_imports, resize, team_restricted_app. Check this before calling autofill, resize, generation, analytics or background-removal tools, which fail for users without the capability.

output.description: The capability names the user holds.

get_oidc_user_info.title: Get OpenID Connect user info
get_oidc_user_info.description: Return the OpenID Connect UserInfo claims for the connected user: sub always, name/given_name/family_name when the `profile` scope was granted, email/email_verified when the `email` scope was granted. Only works for connections authorised with the `openid` scope; otherwise use get_current_user and get_user_profile.
get_oidc_user_info.notes: Documented in Canva's OpenAPI description (operation userInfo); the reference site has no separate page for it.

output.description: The UserInfo claims.

list_designs.title: List designs
list_designs.description: List the designs in the user's projects (owned by or shared with them), with id, title, owner, urls (edit_url, view_url), thumbnail, page_count and timestamps. Search with `query`, filter by ownership and sort. Returns a `continuation` token while more remain. Use list_folder_items to browse a specific folder.

query.description: Search term(s) matched against the user's designs and designs shared with them.

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of designs and the continuation token.

continuation.description: Pass back to get the next page.

get_design.title: Get a design
get_design.description: Get one design's metadata: title, owner, temporary edit_url and view_url, thumbnail (URL valid 15 minutes), page_count, created_at and updated_at. Use get_design_pages for per-page thumbnails and export_design_* tools to get the design's file.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

output.description: The design.

create_design.title: Create a design
create_design.description: Create a new design from a preset type (doc, email, presentation, whiteboard) and/or an image asset placed on it as a flat image. Give design_type, asset_id or both. Returns the design with its edit_url. Use create_custom_design for pixel dimensions, copy_design to duplicate a design, create_design_from_brand_template for a template copy, and generate_design to have Canva write the content from a brief. Blank designs not edited within 7 days are deleted.

design_type.description: Preset design type. Required unless asset_id is given.

asset_id.description: ID of an image asset to insert into the new design. Required unless design_type is given.

output.description: The new design.

create_custom_design.title: Create a custom-size design
create_custom_design.description: Create a new blank design with custom pixel dimensions (each side 40-8000 px, total area at most 25,000,000 px), optionally with an image asset placed on it. Returns the design with its edit_url. Use create_design for preset types such as presentations or docs.

asset_id.description: ID of an image asset to insert into the new design.

output.description: The new design.

copy_design.title: Copy a design
copy_design.description: Create a new design that is a copy of an existing design, optionally with only some of its pages. Returns the new design. Preview API. Use create_design_resize_job to copy into a different size.
copy_design.notes: Preview feature: may change without a new API version.

design_id.description: ID of the design to copy.

page_numbers.description: One-based page numbers to copy. Omit to copy every page.

output.description: The new design.

create_design_from_brand_template.title: Create a design from a brand template
create_design_from_brand_template.description: Create a new editable design as a copy of a brand template, optionally with only some of its pages. Returns the new design. Preview API. To fill the template's data fields with content, use create_autofill_from_brand_template instead.
create_design_from_brand_template.notes: Preview feature: may change without a new API version.

brand_template_id.description: ID of the brand template, from list_brand_templates.

page_numbers.description: One-based page numbers to copy. Omit to copy every page.

output.description: The new design.

get_design_pages.title: List a design's pages
get_design_pages.description: List page metadata for a design: page id, page_number, dimensions and a per-page thumbnail. Page through with offset and limit. Some design types (such as Canva docs) have no pages. Preview API. Page ids feed get_design_analytics_page_views.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

offset.description: One-based page number to start from (default 1).

limit.description: Number of pages to return (1-200, default 50).

output.description: The pages.

get_design_export_formats.title: List a design's export formats
get_design_export_formats.description: List which file formats a design can be exported to (pdf, jpg, png, gif, pptx, mp4, csv, html_bundle, html_standalone, svg ...), with the page numbers that support each when not all do. Call before an export_design_* tool if unsure the format applies.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

output.description: A map of format name to its options.

get_design_dataset.title: Get a design's autofill dataset
get_design_dataset.description: Get the autofill data fields defined in a design: a map of field name to type (image, text, chart, sheet). Use the names and types to build `data` for create_autofill_from_design or autofill_design_in_place. For brand templates use get_brand_template_dataset.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

output.description: Map of data field name to its type.

generate_design.title: Generate a design from a brief
generate_design.description: Start an AI job that generates a Canva doc or presentation from a text brief, optionally following a slide outline. Consumes the user's AI credits and needs the design_generation capability. Returns a job; poll get_design_generation_job until status is success to get the new design. Preview API.
generate_design.notes: Preview API; requires the design_generation capability and consumes AI credits (429 credit_quota_exceeded when exhausted).

brief.description: What to generate: subject, purpose, required wording, tone and visual direction (up to 5000 characters).

design_type.description: The kind of design to generate.

outline_sections.description: Presentations only: ordered slides, each {"title": str, "description": str (optional), "points": [str] (optional)}.

output.description: The design generation job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

get_design_generation_job.title: Get a design generation job
get_design_generation_job.description: Poll a design generation job started with generate_design. When status is success, result.design holds the generated design's id, title, url and thumbnail. Polling does not consume AI credits; jobs expire 24 hours after creation.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by generate_design.

output.description: The design generation job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

import_design_from_url.title: Import a file from a URL as a design
import_design_from_url.description: Start a job that imports a publicly reachable file (PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, Keynote, Pages, Numbers, AI, PSD, Affinity, OpenOffice ...) as a new editable Canva design. Returns a job; poll get_url_import_job. Use import_image_as_design to turn an image asset into layered design.

url.description: Public URL of the file to import.

title.description: Title for the new design (1-255 characters).

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. application/pdf. Canva detects it when omitted.

output.description: The URL import job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: designs: the imported design(s); large files may split into several.

get_url_import_job.title: Get a URL import job
get_url_import_job.description: Poll a design import started with import_design_from_url. When status is success, result.designs lists the imported design(s) with id, title, url and thumbnail; on failure error explains why.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by import_design_from_url.

output.description: The URL import job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: designs: the imported design(s).

get_design_import_job.title: Get a file design import job
get_design_import_job.description: Poll a design import job created by Canva's binary file-upload import endpoint (POST /v1/imports). When status is success, result.designs lists the imported design(s). To start an import from this package use import_design_from_url.

output.description: The design import job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: designs: the imported design(s).

import_image_as_design.title: Convert an image into an editable design
import_image_as_design.description: Start a Magic Layers job that converts an image asset already in the user's account (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP, HEIC, TIFF ...; not SVG or video) into a design whose elements are separate editable layers. Best for flat graphics like posters and flyers. Consumes AI credits and needs the image_to_design_imports capability. Poll get_image_to_design_import_job. Preview API.
import_image_as_design.notes: Preview API; requires the image_to_design_imports capability and consumes AI credits.

asset_id.description: ID of the image asset to convert.

title.description: Title for the new design. Canva generates one when omitted.

output.description: The image-to-design import job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

get_image_to_design_import_job.title: Get an image-to-design import job
get_image_to_design_import_job.description: Poll a job started with import_image_as_design. When status is success, result.design holds the new layered design's id, title, url and thumbnail.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by import_image_as_design.

output.description: The image-to-design import job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

export_design_as_pdf.title: Export a design as PDF
export_design_as_pdf.description: Start a job exporting a design as a PDF, optionally only some pages and, for Canva docs, at a given paper size. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_pdf.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

export_quality.description: regular (default) or pro. A pro export fails if the design has premium elements the user hasn't licensed.

size.description: Paper size; only applies to Canva docs. Default a4.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_jpg.title: Export a design as JPG
export_design_as_jpg.description: Start a job exporting a design as JPEG images at a chosen compression quality, optionally resized (aspect ratio kept) and only some pages. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_jpg.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100; lower means smaller files with more artifacts.

export_quality.description: regular (default) or pro. A pro export fails if the design has premium elements the user hasn't licensed.

width.description: Output width in pixels (40-25000). Omit both width and height for the design's own size.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_png.title: Export a design as PNG
export_design_as_png.description: Start a job exporting a design as PNG images, optionally resized, lossy-compressed, with a transparent background, merged into one image, or only some pages. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_png.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

export_quality.description: regular (default) or pro. A pro export fails if the design has premium elements the user hasn't licensed.

width.description: Output width in pixels (40-25000). Omit both width and height for the design's own size.

lossless.description: true (default) for uncompressed PNG; false for lossy compression (premium plans only).

transparent_background.description: Export with a transparent background (premium plans only; see the export_png_transparency capability).

as_single_image.description: Merge a multi-page design into a single image instead of one image per page.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_gif.title: Export a design as GIF
export_design_as_gif.description: Start a job exporting a design as a GIF, optionally resized (aspect ratio kept) and only some pages. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_gif.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

export_quality.description: regular (default) or pro. A pro export fails if the design has premium elements the user hasn't licensed.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_mp4.title: Export a design as MP4 video
export_design_as_mp4.description: Start a job exporting a design as an MP4 video at a chosen orientation and resolution, optionally only some pages. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_mp4.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

quality.description: Orientation and resolution of the video.

export_quality.description: regular (default) or pro. A pro export fails if the design has premium elements the user hasn't licensed.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_pptx.title: Export a design as PowerPoint
export_design_as_pptx.description: Start a job exporting a design as a Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) file, optionally only some pages. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_pptx.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_csv.title: Export a design as CSV
export_design_as_csv.description: Start a job exporting a design as CSV (for designs with tabular content such as Canva sheets), optionally only some pages. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_csv.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

export_design_as_html.title: Export a design as HTML
export_design_as_html.description: Start a job exporting a design as HTML: html_bundle (a zip of HTML plus assets) or html_standalone (one self-contained file). Only a single page is exported; the first page when none is given. Returns a job; poll get_export_job until status is success to get download URLs (valid 24 hours). Use get_design_export_formats to check the format is available for the design.
export_design_as_html.notes: Export rate limits: 75 exports per user and per document per 5 minutes, 500 per user per day.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

pages.description: The single one-based page number to export, e.g. [2]. Defaults to the first page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

get_export_job.title: Get an export job
get_export_job.description: Poll an export job started with any export_design_* or export_print_partner_design tool. When status is success, `urls` holds the download URL(s), one per page where applicable, valid for 24 hours. On failure error.code is license_required, approval_required or internal_failure.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.

resize_design.title: Resize a design to custom dimensions
resize_design.description: Start a job that creates a resized copy of a design at custom pixel dimensions (each side 40-8000 px, area at most 25,000,000 px). Creates a new design in the user's root projects folder; the original is untouched. Docs, emails and Canva Code designs cannot be resized. Needs a premium plan (resize capability; free users get a limited trial). Poll get_resize_job.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

output.description: The resize job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

resize_design_to_preset.title: Resize a design to a preset type
resize_design_to_preset.description: Start a job that creates a copy of a design converted to a preset design type (presentation or whiteboard; doc and email are not valid resize targets in practice). Creates a new design in the user's root projects folder; the original is untouched. Docs, emails and Canva Code designs cannot be resized. Needs a premium plan (resize capability; free users get a limited trial). Poll get_resize_job.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

output.description: The resize job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

get_resize_job.title: Get a resize job
get_resize_job.description: Poll a resize job started with resize_design or resize_design_to_preset. When status is success, result.design holds the new resized design's id, title, url and thumbnail.

output.description: The resize job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

create_merged_design.title: Merge pages into a new design
create_merged_design.description: Start a job that builds a new design by inserting pages from one or more existing designs (insert_pages operations only). Returns a job; poll get_merge_job for the new design. Preview API. Use modify_design_pages to change an existing design.

title.description: Title for the new design (1-255 characters).

operations.description: Page operations, applied in order (only one per request unless Canva enabled multi-operation mode for the app). Shapes: {"type": "insert_pages", "source": {"type": "design", "design_id": str, "page_numbers": [int] (optional)}, "after_page_number": int (optional; 0 = start, default append)}; {"type": "move_pages", "from_page_numbers": [int], "to_after_page_number": int}; {"type": "delete_pages", "page_numbers": [int]}. Only insert_pages is allowed here.

output.description: The design merge job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

modify_design_pages.title: Insert, move or delete pages in a design
modify_design_pages.description: Start a job that edits an existing design's pages: insert pages from other designs, reorder pages, or delete pages. Deleting pages changes the design in place. Returns a job; poll get_merge_job. Preview API.
modify_design_pages.notes: Preview API. delete_pages operations remove pages from the design.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

operations.description: Page operations, applied in order (only one per request unless Canva enabled multi-operation mode for the app). Shapes: {"type": "insert_pages", "source": {"type": "design", "design_id": str, "page_numbers": [int] (optional)}, "after_page_number": int (optional; 0 = start, default append)}; {"type": "move_pages", "from_page_numbers": [int], "to_after_page_number": int}; {"type": "delete_pages", "page_numbers": [int]}.

output.description: The design merge job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

get_merge_job.title: Get a design merge job
get_merge_job.description: Poll a job started with create_merged_design or modify_design_pages. When status is success, result.design holds the created or updated design's id, title, url and thumbnail.

output.description: The design merge job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: Holds the design (id, title, url, thumbnail) on success.

create_autofill_from_brand_template.title: Autofill a brand template
create_autofill_from_brand_template.description: Start a job that creates a new design from a brand template with its data fields filled with your text, images, videos, charts or sheets. Get the field names first with get_brand_template_dataset. Returns a job; poll get_autofill_job for the new design.
create_autofill_from_brand_template.notes: Needs a Canva Pro, Teams, Enterprise, Education or Nonprofits user (autofill capability).

brand_template_id.description: ID of the brand template, from list_brand_templates (filter dataset=non_empty).

data.description: Map of data field name (from get_brand_template_dataset or get_design_dataset) to value: {"type": "text", "text": str}; {"type": "image", "asset_id": str}; {"type": "video", "asset_id": str}; {"type": "chart", "chart_data": {"column_configs": [{"name": str, "type": "string|number|date|boolean"}] (optional), "rows": [{"cells": [{"type": "string|number|boolean|date", "value": ...}]}]}}; {"type": "sheet", "sheet_data": same shape as chart_data}. Dates are Unix seconds.

title.description: Title for the new design. Defaults to the template's title.

output.description: The autofill job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: type create_design or update_design, with design (id, title, url, thumbnail).

create_autofill_from_design.title: Autofill a copy of a design
create_autofill_from_design.description: Start a job that creates a new design from an existing design that has autofill data fields, with those fields filled in. Get the field names first with get_design_dataset. The source design is unchanged. Poll get_autofill_job.
create_autofill_from_design.notes: Needs a Canva Pro, Teams, Enterprise, Education or Nonprofits user (autofill capability).

design_id.description: ID of the source design with data fields.

data.description: Map of data field name (from get_brand_template_dataset or get_design_dataset) to value: {"type": "text", "text": str}; {"type": "image", "asset_id": str}; {"type": "video", "asset_id": str}; {"type": "chart", "chart_data": {"column_configs": [{"name": str, "type": "string|number|date|boolean"}] (optional), "rows": [{"cells": [{"type": "string|number|boolean|date", "value": ...}]}]}}; {"type": "sheet", "sheet_data": same shape as chart_data}. Dates are Unix seconds.

title.description: Title for the new design. Defaults to the source design's title.

output.description: The autofill job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: type create_design or update_design, with design (id, title, url, thumbnail).

autofill_design_in_place.title: Autofill a design in place
autofill_design_in_place.description: Start a job that overwrites the data fields of an existing design with new content, rather than creating a copy. Get the field names first with get_design_dataset. Poll get_autofill_job. Use create_autofill_from_design to keep the original.
autofill_design_in_place.notes: Needs a Canva Pro, Teams, Enterprise, Education or Nonprofits user (autofill capability). Replaces the field contents of the existing design.

design_id.description: ID of the design to update.

data.description: Map of data field name (from get_brand_template_dataset or get_design_dataset) to value: {"type": "text", "text": str}; {"type": "image", "asset_id": str}; {"type": "video", "asset_id": str}; {"type": "chart", "chart_data": {"column_configs": [{"name": str, "type": "string|number|date|boolean"}] (optional), "rows": [{"cells": [{"type": "string|number|boolean|date", "value": ...}]}]}}; {"type": "sheet", "sheet_data": same shape as chart_data}. Dates are Unix seconds.

output.description: The autofill job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: type create_design or update_design, with design (id, title, url, thumbnail).

get_autofill_job.title: Get an autofill job
get_autofill_job.description: Poll an autofill job started with create_autofill_from_brand_template, create_autofill_from_design or autofill_design_in_place. When status is success, result.design holds the created or updated design.
get_autofill_job.notes: Needs a Canva Pro, Teams, Enterprise, Education or Nonprofits user (autofill capability).

output.description: The autofill job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: type create_design or update_design, with design (id, title, url, thumbnail).

list_brand_templates.title: List brand templates
list_brand_templates.description: List the brand templates the user can access, with id, title, view_url, create_url, thumbnail and timestamps. Search with `query`; set dataset=non_empty for only templates with autofill fields. Returns a continuation token while more remain.
list_brand_templates.notes: Needs a user on a plan with brand templates (Canva Pro, Teams or Enterprise).

dataset.description: any, or non_empty for only templates with autofill data fields.

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of brand templates.

get_brand_template.title: Get a brand template
get_brand_template.description: Get one brand template's metadata: title, view_url, create_url, thumbnail, created_at and updated_at. Use get_brand_template_dataset for its autofill fields.
get_brand_template.notes: Needs a user on a plan with brand templates (Canva Pro, Teams or Enterprise).

output.description: The brand template.

get_brand_template_dataset.title: Get a brand template's autofill dataset
get_brand_template_dataset.description: Get the autofill data fields of a brand template: a map of field name to type (image, text, chart, sheet). Use it to build `data` for create_autofill_from_brand_template. An empty map means the template has no fields.
get_brand_template_dataset.notes: Needs a user on a plan with brand templates (Canva Pro, Teams or Enterprise).

output.description: Map of data field name to its type.

publish_brand_template.title: Publish a design as a brand template
publish_brand_template.description: Publish a design as a brand template shared with the team. If the design is a draft of an existing brand template, that template is updated (republished); otherwise a new template is created. Returns the template; its thumbnail may be null until generated. Needs a Team admin, Brand designer, Organization admin or Organization designer role. Preview API.
publish_brand_template.notes: Preview API. Needs a user on a plan with brand templates (Canva Pro, Teams or Enterprise). Republishing overwrites the live template for the whole team.

design_id.description: ID of the design to publish.

output.description: The published brand template.

get_asset.title: Get an asset
get_asset.description: Get an uploaded asset's metadata: type (image or video), name, tags, owner, thumbnail and timestamps. Asset IDs come from upload jobs, list_folder_items (image items) or generation results.

output.description: The asset.

update_asset.title: Rename or retag an asset
update_asset.description: Update an asset's name and/or tags. `tags` replaces every existing tag; omit it to leave tags alone. Returns the updated asset.

name.description: New name shown in the Canva UI (up to 50 characters).

tags.description: Replacement tags (up to 50, each up to 50 characters).

output.description: The updated asset.

delete_asset.title: Delete an asset
delete_asset.description: Move an asset to the user's trash, as deleting in the Canva UI does. Designs already using the asset keep it.

output.description: Empty on success.

upload_asset_from_url.title: Upload an asset from a URL
upload_asset_from_url.description: Start a job that uploads an image (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, GIF, TIFF, WEBP; under 50 MB) or video (MP4, MOV, MKV, MPEG, WebM, M4V; up to 100 MB from a URL) from a public URL into the user's content library. Returns a job; poll get_url_asset_upload_job for the new asset ID.

output.description: The asset upload job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

asset.description: The new asset once status is success.

get_url_asset_upload_job.title: Get a URL asset upload job
get_url_asset_upload_job.description: Poll an upload started with upload_asset_from_url. When status is success, `asset` holds the new asset (id, name, type, thumbnail); on failure error.code is file_too_big, import_failed or fetch_failed.

output.description: The asset upload job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

asset.description: The new asset once status is success.

get_asset_upload_job.title: Get a file asset upload job
get_asset_upload_job.description: Poll an asset upload job created by Canva's binary file-upload endpoint (POST /v1/asset-uploads). When status is success, `asset` holds the new asset. To start an upload from this package use upload_asset_from_url.

output.description: The asset upload job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

asset.description: The new asset once status is success.

generate_image.title: Generate an image with AI
generate_image.description: Start an AI job that generates an image from a text prompt. The result has a download URL valid 24 hours; set asset_upload_type=upload to also save it as an image asset in the user's Uploads. Consumes AI credits and needs the image_generation capability. Poll get_image_generation_job. Preview API.
generate_image.notes: Preview API; requires the image_generation capability and consumes AI credits (429 credit_quota_exceeded when exhausted).

prompt.description: Plain-text description of the image (up to 10000 characters).

idempotency_key.description: A fresh UUID. Retrying with the same key within 24 hours returns the original job instead of a duplicate.

model.description: Pin a model; best omitted so Canva picks and falls back. craft_v1_2k: general/marketing; lucid_origin: architecture, logos, sci-fi; z_image_turbo: images with text, food.

asset_upload_type.description: upload to save the image as an asset too; none (or omit) for only a download URL.

asset_name.description: Name for the saved asset when asset_upload_type is upload.

output.description: The image generation job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: image: url (24h download) and asset when saved, plus width and height.

get_image_generation_job.title: Get an image generation job
get_image_generation_job.description: Poll a job started with generate_image. When status is success, result.image holds the download URL (valid 24 hours) and, if saved, the asset. Only the app and user that created the job can read it.

output.description: The image generation job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: image: url, asset, width, height.

transform_image.title: Transform an image asset (remove background)
transform_image.description: Start a job that applies transformations, currently only background_removal, to an image asset and saves the result as a new image asset; the source asset is untouched. The asset must have finished uploading. Consumes AI credits; background removal needs the background_removal capability. The job may complete immediately; otherwise poll get_image_transformation_job. Preview API.

asset_id.description: ID of the source image asset.

name.description: Name for the new asset. Defaults to the source asset's name.

output.description: The image transformation job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: asset: the new image asset.

get_image_transformation_job.title: Get an image transformation job
get_image_transformation_job.description: Poll a job started with transform_image. When status is success, result.asset holds the new transformed image asset.

output.description: The image transformation job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

result.description: asset: the new image asset.

list_folder_items.title: List items in a folder
list_folder_items.description: List the folders, designs, image assets and (only when asked for in item_types) brand templates in a folder, each with its type and metadata. Use folder_id `root` for the top of the user's projects or `uploads` for Uploads. Video assets are not returned. Returns a continuation token while more remain.

folder_id.description: The folder ID. `root` is the top level of the user's projects; `uploads` is their Uploads folder.

item_types.description: Comma-separated subset of design, folder, image, brand_template. Defaults to design,folder,image.

pin_status.description: any (default) or pinned for only pinned items.

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of folder items.

items.description: Each has type plus a folder, design, image or brand_template object.

get_folder.title: Get a folder
get_folder.description: Get a folder's name, thumbnail and created/updated timestamps. Use list_folder_items for its contents.

folder_id.description: The folder ID. `root` is the top level of the user's projects; `uploads` is their Uploads folder.

output.description: The folder.

create_folder.title: Create a folder
create_folder.description: Create a folder at the top of the user's projects (parent `root`), in Uploads (parent `uploads`), or inside another folder. Returns the new folder with its ID.

output.description: The new folder.

rename_folder.title: Rename a folder
rename_folder.description: Change a folder's name (the only folder property the API can update). Returns the updated folder.

output.description: The updated folder.

delete_folder.title: Delete a folder
delete_folder.description: Delete a folder. The user's own content in it moves to the trash; content owned by others moves back to the top level of its owner's projects.

output.description: Empty on success.

move_folder_item.title: Move an item to another folder
move_folder_item.description: Move a design, folder or image asset into another folder (`root` for the top of the user's projects). Fails with item_in_multiple_folders if the item lives in several folders; that case must be handled in the Canva UI. Video assets cannot be moved.

item_id.description: ID of the design, folder or asset to move.

output.description: Empty on success.

create_comment_thread.title: Comment on a design
create_comment_thread.description: Start a new comment thread on a design, optionally assigned to a user. Mention users with `[user_id:team_id]` in the message; an assignee must be mentioned. Returns the thread with its ID for replies. Preview API; there is no endpoint to list a design's threads.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

assignee_id.description: User ID to assign the comment to; they must be mentioned in the message.

output.description: The new thread.

get_comment_thread.title: Get a comment thread
get_comment_thread.description: Get a comment or suggestion thread on a design: type, content (plaintext and markdown), author, mentions, assignee, resolver and timestamps. Use list_comment_replies for its replies. Preview API.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

thread_id.description: The comment thread ID, from create_comment_thread or a reply's thread_id.

output.description: The thread.

list_comment_replies.title: List replies in a comment thread
list_comment_replies.description: List the replies in a comment or suggestion thread, oldest first, with id, author, content (plaintext and markdown), mentions and timestamps. Returns a continuation token while more remain. Preview API.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

thread_id.description: The comment thread ID, from create_comment_thread or a reply's thread_id.

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of replies.

get_comment_reply.title: Get a comment reply
get_comment_reply.description: Get one reply in a comment or suggestion thread: author, content, mentions and timestamps. Preview API.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

thread_id.description: The comment thread ID, from create_comment_thread or a reply's thread_id.

output.description: The reply.

reply_to_comment_thread.title: Reply to a comment thread
reply_to_comment_thread.description: Post a reply in an existing comment or suggestion thread on a design (at most 100 replies per thread). Mention users with `[user_id:team_id]`. Returns the reply. Preview API.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

thread_id.description: The comment thread ID, from create_comment_thread or a reply's thread_id.

output.description: The new reply.

get_design_analytics.title: Get a design's analytics
get_design_analytics.description: Get aggregated view analytics for a design: total views, unique viewers, total and average view duration in seconds. Use the other get_design_analytics_* tools for viewers, links, time series and per-page data.
get_design_analytics.notes: Preview API; the user must belong to a Canva Enterprise organization (analytics capability).

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

output.description: Aggregated metrics.

list_design_viewers.title: List a design's viewers
list_design_viewers.description: List who viewed a design, most recent first, with viewer_id, user (when visible), viewer type, view counts, durations and last_viewed_at. Without link_id only viewers who did not come through a trackable link are returned. viewer_id feeds get_design_analytics_page_views.
list_design_viewers.notes: Preview API; the user must belong to a Canva Enterprise organization (analytics capability).

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

link_id.description: Only viewers who came through this trackable link (from list_design_tracked_links).

first_viewed_after.description: Only viewers whose first view was after this Unix time (seconds).

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of viewers.

get_design_views_over_time.title: Get a design's views over time
get_design_views_over_time.description: List a design's view counts bucketed over time (each item has bucket_start_at and count), within an optional Unix-seconds range and bucketed in a given UTC offset.
get_design_views_over_time.notes: Preview API; the user must belong to a Canva Enterprise organization (analytics capability).

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

timezone.description: UTC offset used for bucketing, e.g. +10:00. Default +00:00.

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of time buckets.

list_design_tracked_links.title: List a design's trackable links
list_design_tracked_links.description: List the trackable share links of a design with their names and metrics: total and unique views, total and average view duration, last_viewed_at. link_id filters the viewer and page-view tools.
list_design_tracked_links.notes: Preview API; the user must belong to a Canva Enterprise organization (analytics capability).

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of links.

get_design_analytics_page_views.title: Get per-page view durations
get_design_analytics_page_views.description: Get view-duration data for specific pages of a design (page ids from get_design_pages): total and average duration and unique viewers per page. Filter to one viewer (by_viewer), one trackable link (by_link) or the editor's own views (for_editor). Read-only despite using POST.
get_design_analytics_page_views.notes: Preview API; the user must belong to a Canva Enterprise organization (analytics capability).

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

page_ids.description: Page IDs to report on (1-100), from get_design_pages.

filter_type.description: by_viewer (needs viewer_id), by_link (needs link_id) or for_editor.

viewer_id.description: Viewer ID from list_design_viewers, for filter_type by_viewer.

link_id.description: Trackable link ID, for filter_type by_link (or to narrow by_viewer).

continuation.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuation` field. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of per-page durations.

create_print_partner_design_from_product.title: Create a print design from a partner product
create_print_partner_design_from_product.description: Print partners: create a new design for one of your partner product IDs, with optional bleed and page-count proofing that Canva applies in the editor. Returns the design with its URLs. Blank designs not edited within 7 days are permanently deleted.
create_print_partner_design_from_product.notes: Preview API, available only to Canva Print Partners.

bleed.description: Bleed in microns around the design (0-150000, default 3000; 0 for none).

min_pages.description: Minimum page count the user may reduce the design to (1-500).

max_pages.description: Maximum page count the user may grow the design to (1-500).

output.description: The new design.

create_print_partner_design_from_dimensi.title: Create a print design from dimensions
create_print_partner_design_from_dimensi.description: Print partners: create a new design at given physical dimensions, optionally with a product type to match templates in Canva Print's catalogue, plus optional bleed and page-count proofing. Returns the design with its URLs.
create_print_partner_design_from_dimensi.notes: Preview API, available only to Canva Print Partners.

product_type.description: Product type used with the dimensions to find a matching Canva Print product and templates.

bleed.description: Bleed in microns around the design (0-150000, default 3000; 0 for none).

min_pages.description: Minimum page count the user may reduce the design to (1-500).

max_pages.description: Maximum page count the user may grow the design to (1-500).

output.description: The new design.

get_print_partner_design.title: Get a print partner design
get_print_partner_design.description: Print partners: get a design's metadata and URLs with your bleed and page-count proofing encoded into the URLs (Canva doesn't store them).
get_print_partner_design.notes: Preview API, available only to Canva Print Partners.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

bleed.description: Bleed in microns around the design (0-150000, default 3000; 0 for none).

min_pages.description: Minimum page count the user may reduce the design to (1-500).

max_pages.description: Maximum page count the user may grow the design to (1-500).

output.description: The design.

export_print_partner_design.title: Export a print-ready file
export_print_partner_design.description: Print partners: start a job exporting a design as a print-quality PDF (with bleed, crop marks, CMYK and PDF/X options), JPG or PNG, optionally scaled to given dimensions and limited to some pages. Canva docs are not supported. Poll get_export_job for download URLs (valid 24 hours).
export_print_partner_design.notes: Preview API, available only to Canva Print Partners.

design_id.description: The Canva design ID, e.g. from list_designs or a design URL.

bleed.description: PDF only: bleed in microns (0-150000, default 3000); match the value used when creating the design.

cmyk.description: PDF only: convert the colour space to CMYK.

width.description: Export width in `units`; the design must be within 0.3x-3x of the requested size.

units.description: Units for width and height. Default px.

pages.description: One-based page numbers to include. Omit for every page.

output.description: The export job: id, status, and the result once status is success.

error.description: code and message when the job failed.

urls.description: Download URL(s), one per page where applicable; valid for 24 hours.
